retrievalProfile.description: A clean, retro-modern layout featuring a close-up portrait enclosed in a thin, hand-drawn organic frame with minimalist sans-serif text in the corners.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, soft-focus studio portrait of a male subject, framed by a thin, slightly irregular black ink line. The entire composition is set against a wide white margin, with thin-weight sans-serif text placed symmetrically in the top left and right corners.
coreVisualRelationships: The hand-drawn frame creates a tactile contrast against the clean white margin.
The subject's head breaks the top boundary of the inner frame for depth.
Typography is balanced across the top horizontal axis.
Soft, warm skin tones contrast with the stark white and black graphic elements.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large, centered close-up portrait filling 70% of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the hand-drawn black frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top-left text, down through the subject's face, to the top-right text, framed by the white margin.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial white space in the outer margins provides a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-key background with natural, warm skin tones and low-saturation accent colors.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning between letters despite thin weight

typesetting.alignment: left and right justified to corners

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Symmetrical placement of the same font family in different colors.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Provides the geometric circularity seen in the 'e' and 'o'.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a person with warm lighting. Place this portrait inside a square, thin, hand-drawn black ink frame. Surround the frame with a wide, clean white margin.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add thin-weight geometric sans-serif text in the top left corner in a muted red, and in the top right corner in a muted blue. Ensure the text is placed within the white margin area.

verificationChecks: Is the border thin and slightly irregular?
Is there a significant white margin around the image?
Is the portrait lighting soft and warm?

mustRedesign: Do not include specific logos or technical symbols from the bottom margin
postGenerationChecks: Verify the frame is a single, thin, hand-drawn line.
Ensure the text does not touch the frame.
Check that the white margin is uniform on all sides.
Confirm the portrait has a soft, 1980s studio quality.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Hand-drawn Square Frame + Wide White Margin + Corner Hairline Sans-Serif Typography
